description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago's mobile audio-guide stops by text, matching stop titles and transcripts. Returns each stop's title, MP3 URL, and transcript text. Stops carry no artwork id, so match a stop to a work by its title; for a known artwork, artic_get_artworks related_media lists the recordings linked to it. Some stops are in Spanish, and titles are sometimes internal file names. This content is for noncommercial educational and personal use only: keep the copyright notice and cite the Art Institute of Chicago.

page.description: Page to return (1-based); page times limit may not exceed 1,000.

query.description: Text matched against stop titles and transcripts; every word must match. An artwork's title or the artist's surname works well.

name: artic_search_audio_guide

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `page_beyond_window`: page times limit exceeds 1,000, past the reachable search window. `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

license_text.description: License statement from the API, verbatim: noncommercial educational and personal use, with notices retained and the source cited.

next_page.description: Page to request next; absent when nothing remains or the next page would pass the first 1,000 matches.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, more pages exist, or the reachable window is exhausted.

source_citation.description: Citation to keep with any use of this content.

stops.description: Matching stops on this page, in relevance order.

audio_url.description: MP3 URL of the recording, already percent-encoded; absent when none is recorded.

id.description: Audio-guide stop id; no tool fetches a stop by id, so each row carries the full stop.

title.description: Stop title; sometimes an internal file name, and empty when the museum lists none.

transcript.description: Transcript of the recording, sometimes in Spanish; absent when the museum has none.

totalCount.description: Matches for the query, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond this page.

title: Search audio guide
